verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents its own outbound HTTP callback: you pass a webhook_url when starting a run, and Skyvern sends a POST to it when the run reaches a terminal status. A programmatic consumer can receive these, but this is a per-run completion callback rather than a general event subscription. missing for 10: account-level registrable webhook subscriptions, an event-type catalog beyond terminal run status, documented payload schema/signing/retry behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Pass webhook_url when you start a run. Skyvern sends one POST to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status
